title: Quick Fix British Sausages Bangers And Mash
description: A hearty, quick-fix British dish featuring sausages and mash, with a macrobiotic twist using vermicelli rice noodles and clay-pot cooking, and a hint of mustard flavor.

ingredients.name: British sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably made with pork and seasoned with salt, pepper, and herbs

ingredients.name: mashed potatoes
ingredients.notes: made with 2-3 large potatoes, boiled and mashed with butter and milk

ingredients.name: mustard
ingredients.notes: preferably whole-grain mustard for a coarser texture

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: minced and sauteed with the onion

ingredients.name: clay pot
ingredients.notes: for cooking the sausages and noodles

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.notes: for sauteing the onion and garlic

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the clay pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and saute for another minute.
Add the British sausages and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the vermicelli rice noodles and cook according to package instructions.
Meanwhile, prepare the mashed potatoes by boiling 2-3 large potatoes until tender, then mashing with butter and milk.
Stir in the whole-grain mustard into the mashed potatoes.
Serve the sausages and noodles on top of the mashed potatoes, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
